mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-on-week improvement in WORKPLACES mobility (t-3w: -56.4% → t-0w: -45.4%, a 11-point recovery) signals resumption of commuting routines. Commuters generate weekday retail footfall via lunch, shopping, and transit-adjacent retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 5 points in any single week.

mechanism_narrative: Declining RESIDENTIAL mobility (t-3w: 25.0% → t-0w: 20.3%, a 4.7-point drop) indicates residents are spending less time at home and more time outside. This behavioral shift toward outdoor activity directly increases retail and recreation visits, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility increases or stabilizes above 20.5% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not show positive week-on-week growth in at least two of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility (t-3w: -65.7% → t-0w: -57.7%, an 8-point recovery) and WORKPLACES mobility (11-point recovery) interact to amplify retail footfall. Transit recovery enables commuters to reach retail districts; workplace recovery creates demand for shopping. Combined effect drives RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve by >5 points cumulatively
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES reverses by >3 points in any week, or RETAIL_REC fails to exceed baseline decline of -64.3% in the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains severely depressed (t-0w: -87.3%), indicating outdoor recreation restrictions remain in force. If PARKS mobility does not recover above -80% within one week, restrictions persist, constraining retail-and-recreation mobility to indoor venues only, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -80% in week t+1w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility recovers above -80% in the next week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 points week-on-week despite PARKS remaining below -80%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has stabilized near -28% (t-2w: -36.0% → t-0w: -28.4%), indicating essential shopping demand is met through efficient, focused trips. This behavioral efficiency frees time and mental bandwidth for discretionary retail-and-recreation visits, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM declines by >3 points in the next week, or RETAIL_REC does not show positive momentum in at least one of the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-June timing in Delhi coincides with monsoon onset and summer holiday season. RESIDENTIAL decline (4.7 points) combined with PARKS suppression (-87.3%) suggests residents are shifting from home confinement toward indoor retail venues (malls, markets) as alternative entertainment. RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks as this substitution effect dominates.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL declines and PARKS remains below -85%
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility increases above 21% or PARKS recovers above -80% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed -60% in any of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility recovery (8-point improvement) is insufficient to sustain retail footfall if WORKPLACES mobility stalls. If WORKPLACES fails to improve beyond -45% in the next week, commuting routines remain incomplete, transit recovery cannot translate to retail visits, and RETAIL_REC remains suppressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES does not improve beyond -45% in week t+1w despite TRANSIT recovery
failure_condition: WORKPLACES improves by >3 points in the next week, or RETAIL_REC increases by >5 points week-on-week in at least two of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility near -28% indicates essential retail remains tightly controlled. If GROCERY_PHARM does not improve further (crossing -25% threshold), authorities maintain strict capacity limits on all retail venues. This spillover restriction keeps RETAIL_REC suppressed over the next four weeks despite workplace and transit recovery.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM fails to cross -25% threshold within two weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM crosses -25% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 8 points from t-0w baseline despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -25%.
